instruction: Open the Extension Manager in LibreOffice Writer.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Extension Manager, clicked 'Get more extensions online', navigated to extensions.libreoffice.org, found LanguageTool page, clicked Download. Download was too slow (232MB .oxt) and never completed. Spent remaining turns trying to use corrupt .crdownload file and checking terminal.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, navigate to extensions.libreoffice.org, search for extensions, interact with LibreOffice menus and Extension Manager dialog, use terminal commands
metadata.failure_analysis: LanguageTool-6.4.oxt download (232MB) was too slow and never completed within 50 turns. Model tried to open incomplete .crdownload file which was corrupt.
metadata.task_rationale: Extracted the first successful sub-step from the original trajectory: the model successfully opened the Extension Manager dialog via Tools menu
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Extension Manager dialog in LibreOffice Writer (via Tools > Extension Manager). Evaluator checks accessibility tree for the presence of the Extension Manager dialog element.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_accessibility_tree) correctly extracts the current UI state as XML, which is appropriate for verifying dialog presence.
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly parses the XML and evaluates the xpath '//dialog[@name="Extension Manager"]' to check if the Extension Manager dialog exists.
The xpath accurately targets the Extension Manager dialog by name, which is the standard accessibility tree representation for LibreOffice dialogs.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (open the Extension Manager) is fully verified by checking dialog presence.
No postconfig needed - the dialog remains open for evaluation after the agent opens it.
